name: Hypernetwork-based Object Embedding
definition: A Hypernetwork (HN) maps an embedding vector $z_j$ to the weights $w_j$ of the scene representation network, allowing generalization across a class of objects by assuming weights lie in a low-dimensional subspace.
summary: Hypernetwork-based Object Embedding maps compact vectors to scene network weights, enabling efficient generalization across object classes via test-time optimization rather than direct evaluation.
